verdict.rationale: First-party GitHub material says Weaviate can easily be started locally with Docker, alongside a local embedding model, and lists Docker as an official deployment option. That covers the lightweight local-instance path. Embedded in-process use is supported only by a community report that Weaviate can run as an embedded Python package and is easy to get running locally. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of embedded in-process mode, explicit guidance on resource footprint or suitability for small workloads, and hands-on corroboration of the embedded package.
